V4 keeps V3's safe span geometry, explicitly flags source-review conflicts, corrects the annual-gifts boundary, and marks all semantic labels UNKNOWN for Gold purposes.

prior_v4_comparison.Groups: V4 is the best current pilot candidate, not a production-ready full-corpus alignment.
Repeated boats/certificate clause at the fee transition; number-heavy OCR in 0186-003, 0187-001/002 and 0188-004; Han page-3 continuation for VI 0189-001..004.
Run the same frozen rules on fresh held-out windows in both Caps; independently adjudicate all changed groups before production integration.
